reviewType: Independent counterpart instruction review; not independent runtime qualification

skillFindings.distinction: Muse covers broad visual/accessibility and async-state direction. This specialist owns complete journeys, separate source/scan/keyboard/actual-AT evidence, composite-widget navigation, removed-trigger successors and remediation closure.
skillFindings.mechanics: Active-only modal containment; meaningful focus successor; cancelled/late-response checks; persistent labels/help/error relationships, stable repeated announcements, correction/resubmission and adaptation-specific regression.
skillFindings.failureHandling: Untested announcements stay untested; unreproduced scan findings stay candidates; new traps or blocked recovery require revised repairs.
skillFindings.tradeoffs: Preserves design and orientation rather than eliminating motion indiscriminately; selects representative shared/unique transitions and high-impact task barriers without equating issue counts to coverage.
skillFindings.guarantees: No automatic conformance/legal certification, universal numeric rules or real-AT claims from DOM assertions.

skillFindings.distinction: Daedalus has general telemetry/integration and expected-event ledger methods. This specialist owns eligible logical events versus attempts, event-weighted aggregation, coverage uncertainty, request-budget units and actionable burn behavior.
skillFindings.mechanics: Summed compatible counters, reset treatment, compatible histogram aggregation, independently known unknown-outcome bounds, undefined zero-traffic ratios, zero-allowance 100% handling and recent/sustained alert windows.
skillFindings.failureHandling: Collector/query failure distinct from service failure; incomplete windows cannot certify a whole period; sparse traffic, resets, gaps, late correction and recovery are explicit test cases.
skillFindings.tradeoffs: A small outcome-focused indicator set and bounded cardinality preserve operability; alert windows/thresholds follow traffic, budget consumption and response capacity rather than a universal recipe.
skillFindings.guarantees: Arithmetic is correctly scoped to one complete population; no event-to-downtime conversion, automatic release authority or live reliability claim from fixtures.

skillFindings.distinction: Atlas sketches staged schemas. This specialist adds mixed reader/writer topology, source-version and target-state atomic conflict checks, future old-writer synchronization, committed range progress and phase-specific recovery.
skillFindings.mechanics: Expand/compatible writers/backfill/read switch/contract; reread or bounded reconciliation on conflicts; CDC position/order/delete/lag obligations; stable ranges plus late insert/conflict ledger; semantic and count validation.
skillFindings.failureHandling: Unknown commits are reconciled before replay; checkpoint exhaustion cannot close unresolved/late work; limits stop affected batches; lossy contraction retains originals and separate reversion/restore boundaries.
skillFindings.tradeoffs: Bounded batch rows/time, short transactions and measured lock/lag throttling trade speed for live capacity; a coordinated pause remains an honest alternative to unsupported zero downtime.
skillFindings.guarantees: Neither null-only updates nor one successful CAS solve future writes; no generic transactional-DDL, lossless down or table-copy restore guarantee.

skillFindings.distinction: Aegis covers general source/sink trust and inert-source review. This specialist reconciles declared/resolved/build/runtime component identities and binds integrity, origin, build provenance, exposure and repair to consumed artifacts.
skillFindings.mechanics: Exact version/origin/digest and build/runtime roles; base/platform/vendored/plugin coverage; digest subject and expected identity/policy checks; advisory date/platform/path evidence; complete resolution diff and repair regression.
skillFindings.failureHandling: Unknown inventory/provenance/advisory coverage is retained; origin/digest mismatch stops affected consumption without blocking independent analysis; prohibited hook execution cannot be silently introduced.
skillFindings.tradeoffs: Uses supplied artifacts and approved tools without mandatory scanner installation; richer inventories cost effort but remain bounded by the actual consumption surface. Static reachability and authenticated signatures are useful evidence, not absolutes.
skillFindings.guarantees: Hashes are reference-relative; signatures do not establish benign code, complete inventories or reproducibility; root license signals are not legal clearance.

sourceBindingChecks.useful: Native controls, field/error association, accessible names and focus behavior.
sourceBindingChecks.rejected: Conversation-wide activation, universal individual tab stops, universal heading rules and fixed severity order.

sourceBindingChecks.read: relevant frozen passages on keyboard/focus, assistive-technology observation, forms/adaptation, testing and unsupported detection percentages
sourceBindingChecks.useful: Journey-level keyboard and actual assistive-technology testing, adaptation and reproduction evidence.
sourceBindingChecks.rejected: Persona and templates, assumed defects, scanner/manual percentage claims and blanket conformance from incomplete observation.
Missing telemetry as a ban on useful measurement design; mandatory clarification without material uncertainty.

sourceBindingChecks.read: relevant frozen passages on request ratios, histogram aggregation, budget arithmetic, paired alert windows and illustrative constants
sourceBindingChecks.useful: Summed event counts, compatible distributions, recent plus sustained burn observations.
sourceBindingChecks.rejected: Expected-uptime-minus-actual arithmetic as budget consumption, consumed-fraction-as-rate projections, reversed window names and universal vendor constants; executable templates were not adopted.

sourceBindingChecks.useful: Traffic, latency, errors, saturation and response ownership.
sourceBindingChecks.rejected: Persona, universal cost/risk multipliers, automatic shipping from budget and fixed automation/rollout recipes.

sourceBindingChecks.read: relevant frozen passages on transactions, additive migration, bulk transformation, backup-table restore and universal down/rollback advice
sourceBindingChecks.rejected: Bulk/unchecked transformation, destructive table recreation as restoration, always-invertible down methods and assumed cross-engine transaction behavior.

sourceBindingChecks.read: relevant frozen passages on component inventory, artifacts, build integrity, exposure and tool/priority recipes
sourceBindingChecks.useful: Dependency inventory across build boundaries, consumed artifact integrity and exposure triage.
sourceBindingChecks.rejected: Fixed percentages/priorities, mandatory tool or exploit execution and signature-as-trust guarantee.

sourceBindingChecks.useful: Exact-version confirmation and separating inventory from advisory analysis.
sourceBindingChecks.rejected: Dated vendor tables, fixed risk formulas, exploit acquisition and unsolicited recurring scans.
Absence of manifests or upgrade permission as a reason to reject audit; automatic fixes and scanner-derived license clearance.

limits: Read all four current entrypoints, metadata and methods fully; compared all four current owner entrypoints, metadata and methods fully. Frozen sources were inert research DATA; source read coverage is specified per body.
No product changes during review; no acquisition, providers, agent descendants, third-party source execution, installation, commits or accounts/security changes.

Counterpart authorship is distinct from reviewer authorship; review is not blinded. These are instruction/package judgments, not live browser/AT, service, database or build/runtime validation, superiority, certification or release/deployment acceptance.

Provenance checks establish bindings to the frozen manifest, not source-specific legal clearance, exhaustive originality proof or warehouse/source terminal disposition. R10 outcomes were not inferred.
